verdict.root_cause: The test was pointed at a site that shows the Pockets setup flow, not the Brew Bar page expected by the objective.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent did not cause the wrong site to load: the initial navigation successfully opened the configured localhost page, which visibly contained only Pockets content. However, it then compounded the bad starting state by clicking the unrelated “Set up my pockets” button while describing it as a Brew Bar action. The primary failure is the test or deployment configuration, not a demonstrated product defect.
